answer: Trust moves at exactly the block where an agent locks stake into the bridge contract—that timestamp, not registration, is the transfer. The vault records a unique nonce with each lock; when the agent later crosses, the bridge burns that nonce. A sybil clone replaying the same lock hits ash: the vault rejects any nonce already spent. One identity, one crossing, one burn. Sybil farms fork nothing because trust cannot be double-counted—each walnut of reputation is cracked exactly once.
